s.g: Of or relating to fat, sebum.
A domestic goose of a breed descended from the European greylag, with long, white curly feathers.
(pathology) A skin disorder causing scaly, flaky, itchy, red skin.
Of, pertaining to or affected by seborrhea.
Standard spelling of (UK and Commonwealth) seborrheic
A bantam chicken of a particular British breed.
(physiology) A thick oily substance, secreted by the sebaceous glands of the skin, that consists of fat, keratin and cellular debris.
